title: Corrigan Moving Systems
description: Corrigan Moving Systems is a full-service relocation company headquartered in Farmington Hills, Michigan. Founded in 1929, the company provides residential and commercial moving services to customers worldwide. Its offerings include local, long-distance, and international moving, as well as packing, storage, car shipping, and piano moving. The company serves a diverse range of commercial clients, including offices, schools, universities, healthcare facilities, and industrial warehouses, providing specialized services such as project management, decommissioning, and asset management. These solutions are delivered through a network of 14 physical locations across Illinois, Michigan, New York, Ohio, and Pennsylvania. Status: Not paid. Data publication: 2026-11-27 05:42 UTC. Revenue: $113.6M. Employees: 1000. Data type: Contracts, accounting, banking, clientsData, confidential, tradeSecret.
